title: Scrutiny for the post of Controller of Examinations (BPS-20)
labels: Notification From Office of The Registrar
text:
Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan

Official University Announcement

SCRUTINY RESULTS ANNOUNCED

Controller of Examinations (BPS-20)
– Advertisement No. 68 (2026)

Reference:
Advertisement No. 68 (2026)

Advertisement Date:
July 8, 2026

Position:
Controller of Examinations (BPS-20)

Application Closing Date:
August 10, 2026

With reference to Advertisement No. 68 (2026), published in
national dailies and on the University's official website on
July 8, 2026, applications were invited for the position of
Controller of Examinations (BPS-20), with August 10, 2026,
as the closing date.

In this regard, all applications received by the prescribed
deadline have been scrutinized by the Scrutiny Committee in
accordance with the relevant provisions of the applicable
Statutes. The scrutiny results are hereby displayed for
information of the candidates.

View Scrutiny Results

Candidates can check their scrutiny status and observations online.

VIEW SCRUTINY RESULTS (https://jobs.awkum.edu.pk/merit/V32Gnm7JKP0AE8OYidTlOHMgpdEQb9AogmOBbmsnrbFQJVtV)

OPEN JOB PORTAL (https://jobs.awkum.edu.pk/)

In accordance with Section 5(8) of the Abdul Wali Khan
University Mardan Administrative Officers Appointment and
Scales of Pay Statutes, 2016 (Amended 2025), any candidate
aggrieved by the decision of the Scrutiny Committee may
file an appeal within fifteen (15) days of communication
of the decision, subject to the following instructions:

Important Instructions for Candidates

The displayed results are provisional and reflect the
outcome of scrutiny of applications only.

They shall not be construed as a merit list or a final
decision regarding selection for the advertised position.

Candidates are advised to carefully examine their
scrutiny status and the observations, if any, recorded
against their applications by logging into the University
job portal using their original application credentials.

In case of login difficulties, candidates may follow
the instructions available on the portal to recover access.

Any candidate aggrieved by the scrutiny decision may
file an appeal within the prescribed period, clearly
specifying the grounds of objection through the online portal.

Appeals shall be considered strictly on the basis of
documentary evidence already submitted by the candidates
at the time of application.

Appeals shall only be submitted through the online portal.
Appeals submitted through any other means shall not be
acceptable or considered.

No new documents or qualifications acquired after the
closing date shall be entertained during the appeal process.

Errors and omissions are liable for rectification.

IMPORTANT: LAST DATE FOR SUBMISSION OF APPEALS

November 27, 2026

All appeals must be submitted online through the University
job portal within the prescribed period.

SUBMIT APPEAL ONLINE (https://jobs.awkum.edu.pk/)

Note:

Candidates are advised to regularly visit the University
job portal and carefully review their scrutiny status to
ensure timely submission of any appeal, where required.

Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan

Official Website:

www.awkum.edu.pk (https://awkum.edu.pk/)
